What is wrong: Rescue sign-up (/register-rescue) cannot register anyone. The server returns 401 "authentication required" for visitors, the form never sends the required contact person, and no owner account is created.
/terms and /privacy show placeholder and maintainer text such as "Placeholder copy - must be reviewed by legal counsel".
Saving onboarding preferences fails with a 500 (array values sent to the database as the wrong type). Top Picks then shows "Failed to load your top picks".
Removing a staff member only deletes the staff record. The removed user can still create pets for that rescue.
A rescue that is pending approval can create pets. Staff of a suspended rescue can still sign in and create pets.
There is no limited staff role. Every rescue staff member can invite, edit and remove staff and decide applications.
Every staff invitation link ends on "Invitation not found or has expired" because the page reads the wrong part of the server response. Nobody can set up an account from an invite.
Admin actions such as suspend and reactivate are not written to the audit log.
The Unsuspend User button sends the wrong action and gets a 400, so the user stays suspended.
Moderation "Take Action" ignores the chosen action. Resolving or bulk-dismissing a report saves a value the list cannot read, which then breaks the whole Moderation page for every admin.
Bulk Sanction > Suspend User shows "0 succeeded, 1 failed" and the user stays active.
Broadcast notification preview fails with a 500 (the notifications service is missing a setting in docker-compose).
Swiping Like or Pass fails with a 500, so swipes are never saved. The screen still moves to the next pet.
/rescues/:id shows "Rescue Not Found" for a valid rescue.
At phone width (375px) the home, search, pet and chat pages scroll sideways (footer "Manage cookies" button), and the apply form is about 700px wide.
Phone and postcode do not save. The profile shows "Phone: Not provided" after saving and "Member Since" says "Invalid date".
The server accepts an application for a pet that is not available. It is only blocked by hiding the button.
Opening one notification to mark it read fails with a 400.
Nearest first sorting does nothing (falls back to newest).
There is no change-password option in the client app.
Applying twice sends you to the existing application with no message explaining why.
Foster page cannot assign a pet (pickers stay on "Loading pets..."), and a placement status shows as "1" so it cannot be ended.
Event times are an hour out in summer (10:00 shows as 11:00), the edit form opens with empty dates, and create and edit forms share duplicate field ids.
A rescue's website cannot be cleared once set.
Rescue managers get a 403 on Reports and on the pending invitations list.
Setting a pet to "Hold" is refused (the card sends a status the server does not know).
The Edit Staff form rejects real user ids ("Please enter a valid user ID"), so a staff title cannot be changed from the page.
The unread badge on Messages comes back after a page reload.
Archived pets still show in the rescue's Pets list.
Field-permission overrides save but have no effect. Adopters still see a "hidden" field.
The audit log "Failed" status filter leaves out failed sign-ins.

Moderation search box is ignored; ticket Responses tab shows 0 after reload; the Reject Rescue dialog is taller than a 720px screen so its buttons cannot be reached; a short ticket description saved by the server breaks the Support page.

First-time visitors get a "Meet Your New Favorite Feature" popup after about a second. It covers the cookie banner and blocks clicks. The onboarding wizard can also lose answers if the saved profile loads late.
A wrong password shows the raw word "unauthenticated" as the error.
On a pet page with a long description the About card overlaps the "Ask a question" and "View Rescue Profile" buttons at 1280x720.
Starting a chat from a pet ("Message rescue" or "Ask a question") is limited to 10 per day for everyone on the same internet connection. In QA this will hit the limit quickly.
Analytics emits invalid chart values when there is no data, the dashboard has a React missing-key warning, and the dev login panel requests a missing endpoint.
The seed has several pets all named "Buddy", so searching by name is ambiguous.
The client app has no button to report a pet or message, so users cannot send reports to moderators.

Registering with an email that already exists shows no "email in use" message and goes to /check-your-email. This looks like deliberate protection against account guessing, so the expected result in the plan was changed.
